_comment: AAKCD shared alert schema — proposed by Suraj (Recon Agent), merging shared/alert_schema.json and shared/alert_schema.py. Fields marked optional can be left out or null if an agent doesn't produce them.
stage: string — the Cyber Kill Chain stage, e.g. 'reconnaissance', 'delivery', 'exploitation'
severity: string — one of: LOW | MEDIUM | HIGH | CRITICAL (uppercase, exact spelling)
confidence: string — one of: low | medium | high (lowercase, exact spelling)
source_ip: string — attacker/source IP (optional — null if the agent has no IP to report, e.g. a file-based delivery agent)
description: string — one or two plain-English sentences on what was detected and why it matters

evidence._comment: object, not a list of strings — each agent defines its own keys here, but keep it structured so individual values (counts, filenames, hashes, etc.) can be pulled out separately rather than regex-parsed from a sentence

recommended_actions: string — ordered list, at least one item, most important action first
ai_status: string (optional) — 'ok' | 'unavailable', only present if this agent uses an AI enrichment step
ai_summary: string (optional) — AI-written explanation, only if ai_status is 'ok'
ai_recommended_actions: string (optional) — AI-suggested actions, separate from the rule-based recommended_actions above
